verdict.rationale: Pulley is a cap-table and equity-management SaaS, and such a product could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a command-line tool. The docs cover only web UI workflows, and the probes found an llms.txt but no OpenAPI spec, neither of which is a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
